testCases.title: GET request returns 200 for existing resource
steps: Send GET request to valid endpoint with existing ID
testCases.expectedResult: Response status 200, body contains resource data

testCases.title: GET request returns 404 for non-existing resource
steps: Send GET request with non-existing ID

testCases.title: POST request returns 201 on successful creation
steps: Send POST request with valid payload

testCases.title: POST request returns 400 for invalid payload
steps: Send POST request with missing required fields
testCases.expectedResult: Response status 400, validation errors in response

testCases.title: Response matches expected JSON schema
testCases.expectedResult: All required fields present, correct types

testCases.title: Pagination parameters work correctly
steps: Check response has correct count and pagination metadata
testCases.expectedResult: Returns correct number of items, total count, page info

testCases.title: Error response format is consistent
testCases.expectedResult: All errors follow same structure: {error, message, statusCode}
